adopted_semantics.negative_rule: Retain negative/uncertain evidence. Do not repair selected source, adopt a witness as a counted descendant, extend iterations after outputs or rewrite old records to make a mechanism positive. This prohibits adaptive extra execution/instrumentation/repair to obtain a positive outcome; it permits supported completion or continuation of genuinely pending original work through the same owners, requests and frozen controls.

separate_outcomes.bounded_validity: For the actual declared roles, the host enforces both callable routes, original measured data, safe materialization, verified copy and the unchanged runtime/protected-source/control/model/callback/resource/funding boundaries. A successful role-scoped witness does not prove broad semantic compliance, universal competence or a new general sandbox security result.

evidence: initial and changed source plus exact inherited lineage
C own proposal owner executes C source and retains complete C measured feedback
raw callback/returned source and further-child private copy/generation joins
not_sufficient: changed improver only inside an unexercised further child
restoring a host improver into returned source
changed_used_improver.required: A parent-authored literal inherited improver implementation in C differs substantively from its predecessor, and C ACTUALLY executes that changed procedure to author another permitted changed child which successfully generates on the first ordered development task.

separate_outcomes.operational: All declared roles/outcomes complete or explicit partial reason/accounting retained. Completion alone does not establish either source gate.
separate_outcomes.performance: Report original official common-task utility/distinctiveness, literal compliance concerns, failures and all actual costs separately. A successful code/improver mechanism can have worse metrics. No useful-diversity, heldout, human-preference or improved-improver efficacy claim.

evidence: exact P/C/further-child source bytes and hashes
The raw proposal JSON source field matches the literal materialized child source. Preserve hypothesis as explanatory text, not source identity or proof that a change was used.
actual generation owner/source/mount/task and callbacks/output evidence
task_procedure_change.required: Literal source diff establishes a substantive change to an ACTUALLY EXECUTED generation procedure or its used helper/control flow/planning/selection/callback structure, beyond only instruction constants, names or comments.

excluded_basis_fields.draft_rehearsal_supplied_control: Not adopted. Supplied C implementation, synthetic [7,7,7]/[8,6,8] scores, unique weakest index1 and any prescribed planning-call pattern are engineering test controls, not required live outcomes.
excluded_basis_fields.format_and_status: The basis keeps its historical unfrozen draft identity. This new version prospectively adopts the general criteria with the explicit source-field, recovery and role-scope clarifications here; it does not retroactively freeze or relabel the basis.
excluded_basis_fields.prospective_treatment.format: The rehearsal treatment identity is not adopted as actual-live identity. The exact reviewed instruction and seed are separately committed in the new adopted actual-live intent; old rehearsal identity and outcomes remain unchanged.

model_authorship_requirement.C: The counted child must join original P-owned confined proposal execution, original actual provider request/reply receipts, literal raw full-replacement source, materialization, private copy and C generation. Supplied fixtures or host-authored replacements cannot establish this outcome.
model_authorship_requirement.P: P is the declared trusted composed seed2, not claimed to be model-authored.
model_authorship_requirement.W0_and_W1: Treat validity children separately. W1 must be authored by the actual inherited C improver using complete C measured feedback. Its source and first-task generation must join their original owners; neither witness becomes a counted search descendant.
model_authorship_requirement.negative_or_unavailable: Invalid proposals, missing full replacements, capacity stops, refused/incomplete replies, unchanged procedures and missing use evidence remain original negative or inconclusive records.

positive_executed_use_rule.custody_limit: An owner and source hash show which program ran; they do not by themselves show that a particular changed branch, helper or decision executed. A hypothesis, static diff, compilation or good score cannot supply missing branch-use evidence.
positive_executed_use_rule.indeterminate_use: If retained evidence cannot distinguish execution of the changed behavior from an unused change or equivalent default path, record inconclusive for executed use. Do not adaptively instrument, patch, repair or add executions after seeing outcomes to manufacture positive evidence. Supported recovery/completion of genuinely pending original work under the same owners and frozen controls remains permitted.
positive_executed_use_rule.method: Offline review of literal source, original complete measured feedback, original raw callback/request/reply receipts, returned source, confined generation outputs and lineage. This protocol adds no paid semantic judge or private benchmark score.
positive_executed_use_rule.required: For each claimed substantive changed procedure, cite exact before/after source functions or branches and original callback/dataflow/output evidence establishing use of that changed behavior during this declared run.

custody_verifier.independence: Root coordinates preparation and is not represented as an independent human rater.
custody_verifier.responsibility: Verify original actual provider requests/replies, inclusive usage, original C/W1 owner/lineage/private-copy joins, complete measured-feedback joins, literal hashes and all declared completed/stopped/unavailable roles. Report custody and model authorship separately from procedural use.

assignment.instance_provenance: The later result records the actual agent/reviewer identity, model/type, context and method used for each predeclared role. Recording the assigned instance does not change these roles or criteria.

mechanism_reviewer.context: Use the adopted protocol and immutable original evidence in a fresh review context. Retain its own finding record before reconciling with the custody verifier.
mechanism_reviewer.responsibility: Review C generation and C inherited improver separately against P; cite substantive source functions/branches and original callback/dataflow/output evidence of actual use. Treat W0/W1 as validity-only roles and allow negative/inconclusive outcomes.
mechanism_reviewer.role: one fresh-context mechanism reviewer who did not author the actual provider-returned code

review_procedure.disagreement: Preserve both individual records. A factual custody mismatch prevents an established authorship/use finding. Unresolved semantic or executed-use disagreement, or missing evidence, is inconclusive for that outcome; no majority-selected positive. Root may append a clerical-reference reconciliation without rewriting original evidence or adding adaptive executions to manufacture proof.
review_procedure.distinct_claims: Keep operational completion, actual model authorship, task procedure change, changed-used-improver, role-scoped bounded validity, official development performance and scientific effectiveness separate.
review_procedure.independence_limits: Separate contexts/roles may use the same underlying model and are not statistically independent human ratings. Disclose same-model, model/host and context limitations in the result. These engineering reviews provide no EVAL-02 human evidence or IMP-01 efficacy claim.
review_procedure.population: All original declared P/C/W0/W1 roles and all completed, rejected, stopped or unavailable outcomes within the single frozen iteration; no cherry-picked only-positive changes.
review_procedure.when: These roles, method and criteria are adopted before dispatch. Each reviewer retains an individual finding record after original evidence is saved. Freeze both records and the reconciled outcome record before any gate-closure claim.

scope: Prospectively adopted offline engineering review criteria for an actual current-parent model-authored SRC-02/03 observation. This protocol asset creates no execution configuration or spending permission and is not an executable application schema or result.
